parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human GnRH receptor (CHEMBL1855). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records to docs for publication provenance. Join compound_structures as INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Filter target by chembl_id CHEMBL1855 and standard_type IC50. Keep only rows where canonical_smiles is not null and (pubmed_id is not null or doi is not null). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; preserve all qualifying activity rows.
